prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: an exceptionally wide, shallow Lord of the Rings / Mordor desktop application header background. Generate one standalone artwork only, no UI, no text, no buttons. Reference image is color and rendering style reference, not composition to preserve. Requested composition is ENTIRE-WIDTH illustrated panorama, with visible imagery across left, center and right. Aspect ratio 10:1, approximately 3000 by 300 pixels, edge-to-edge without margins. A low, sweeping panoramic view across Mordor: left ancient black stone ramparts and faint molten gold cracks, middle layered jagged mountains, battlements, smoky amber horizon, right Barad-dur with a small fiery eye and distant Mount Doom. All important silhouettes including tower top within the shallow panorama, no tall isolated subject chopped off. Strong horizontal composition. Restrained cinematic realism, finely detailed obsidian stone, ancient bronze highlights, low amber lava glow. Brightness subdued across whole scene for pale native application controls to sit on top; still discernible details throughout the left half. No empty flat black half, no black fadeout at either side. No typography, logo, labels, ornamental frame or fake controls. Black-brown #100E0A, old gold #E8BD68, tiny accents ember orange #FF8944. Keep low contrast around the left quarter where controls will appear, but show stone and scenery there.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: separate Lord of the Rings / Mordor application top menu and status bar material texture. One standalone seamless-looking very wide shallow texture strip, aspect ratio 10:1, approximately 3000 by 300 pixels. Edge-to-edge aged dark obsidian forged metal with delicate ancient gold engraved interlacing linework, subtle scorched bronze edges and tiny faint amber ember fissures. No objects, characters, landscapes, rings, text, recognizable writing, UI, buttons or logos. Dense fine material texture throughout entire width rather than a blank left region. Subdued dark brown-black #100E0A and #211A13; subtle muted antique gold #655336. Elegant, dark and readable as a native application bar with pale labels placed over it later. Low-contrast detail, no bright large lights. Flat front-facing orthographic surface, no perspective. Tiny intricate angular linework at the upper and lower edges and quiet fine brushed stone/metal grain in the center. This is a separate production texture, not a screenshot or moodboard.
gif: User-provided ring.gif copied byte-for-byte, no generation or re-encoding.
